project.name: Prior Muir
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 7 of 13: every visitor category, strict boundary, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, construction dates, access, transport and dogs were rechecked before continuing. Archaeological records are heat evidence, not automatically See attractions. Nearby St Andrews, Dunino and coastal services are not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Limited Visitor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Prior Muir is a dispersed rural locality whose archaeological record adds historical context but not a public visitor experience. No independent attraction, café-led stop, maintained locality trail or public facilities were verified.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Responsible rural access may be possible on public routes, but no dedicated dog visit or dog-welcoming venue is evidenced.
